headline: The PCB inducted Mohammad Yousuf and Sana Mir into the PCB Hall of Fame, taking its membership to 16, Business Recorder reports.

card.desc: Mohammad Yousuf aur Sana Mir Hall of Fame mein shamil.

caption:
Mohammad Yousuf aur Sana Mir PCB Hall of Fame mein shamil! 🏏
Business Recorder ke mutabiq PCB ne Mohammad Yousuf aur Sana Mir ko PCB Hall of Fame mein shamil kar liya hai. Ab Hall of Fame ke members ki tadaad 16 ho gayi hai. Mohammad Yousuf ne 381 international matches mein 17,300 runs banaye. 2006 mein un ke 1,788 Test runs aaj bhi ek calendar saal ka world record hain. Sana Mir ne 226 international matches mein 240 wickets liye aur 2,432 runs banaye. Un ki captaincy mein Pakistan ne 2010 aur 2014 ke Asian Games mein gold medal jeeta.
Aap ka pasandeeda Pakistani cricketer kaun hai? Comment mein batayein 👇
